text: illnesses taking α-flu- pentixol [(Z)-flupentixol or cis-flupentixol] improved more after 3 weeks than patients who were taking equal doses of β-flupen- tixol [(E)-flupentixol or trans-flupentixol] or a placebo.1 The α- isomer had more effect on the positive symptoms of the disease; this difference was less apparent for the negative symptoms. The difference in activity between the isomers was attributed to the greater dopamine-receptor blocking activity of the α-isomer rather than to differences in distribution.2 1. Johnstone EC, et al.
